about: Domains umi is allowed to crawl at tier 4, which is a real browser on a written per domain allowlist. Nothing reaches this tier by learning. A domain is here only because a named person put it here.
engine_note: The allowlist, the opt in, the publishing and the per fetch record are built. The supervised browser is not, so a fetch requested at tier 4 today descends to tier 3 and the row says so.
